title: "Complex Survey Design & Health Outcomes Report"
author: "Nasiba Islam"
format: html
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk.set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(survey)
library(gtsummary)
library(tidyverse)
```

# 1. Complex Survey Specification

```{r survey-design}
data(api, package = "survey")

df_clean <- apistrat %>%
  rename(psu = dnm, strata = stype, weights = pw) %>%
  mutate(high_performer = factor(ifelse(api00 >= 700, "High", "Low")))

svy_design <- svydesign(
  ids = ~psu,
  strata = ~strata,
  weights = ~weights,
  nest = TRUE,
  data = df_clean
)
```

# 2. Survey-Weighted Baseline Table

```{r table-1}
tbl_svysummary(
  svy_design,
  by = high_performer,
  include = c(strata, meals, ell, emer)
) %>%
  add_overall() %>%
  bold_labels()
```

# 3. Survey Logistic Regression

```{r survey-logistic}
logistic_model <- svyglm(
  I(high_performer == "High") ~ meals + ell + emer,
  design = svy_design,
  family = quasibinomial()
)

tbl_regression(logistic_model, exponentiate = TRUE)
```
